request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Remove the grey patches, dark spots and rivets from the red body panels so they are big plain bright red areas with a slightly darker red shadow. Keep every other pixel, the goggled driver in a red cap, the spiked grey ram, the dark iron wheels, the exhaust and soot cloud, pose, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
